device: Apple M4 Max, 48 GiB unified memory

protocol.workload: Handover, same source text with the archived native template and tokenization for each model. Single-slot 4096 context. No output quality scoring on truncated responses.
protocol.repetitions: Two fresh processes per model and fixed budget, Qwen then LFM ascending, then LFM then Qwen descending. One local Metal process at a time. Separate 8-input/8-output warmup, model load and warmup excluded.
protocol.profile: No policy overrides. ATOMIC_WINDOW_PROFILE=1 records existing prefill counters. DFlash2 sidecars installed. Legacy control sets --no-fast-prefill only.
protocol.statistics: Per-cell median of both observations. ttft_s: client POST start to first token-bearing SSE event. tps: 63 / seconds from first to last token. request_s: POST through end of stream. prompt_eval_tps: server prompt tokens / prompt-eval seconds. ledger_peak and process_peaks are bytes.
protocol.reference: Default samples compare 64 output IDs to the archived fast candidate at the same budget. This comparison does not establish full logit equality.
